Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You trace the route in the air and name each companion in turn, turning a crowded battlefield into a sequence of clear steps.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and up to three willing allies within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.
Duration
Movement is immediate; each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Each recipient may move up to 3 squares without provoking, in an order you choose. Each gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. Choose legal routes and separate free endpoints.

Additional rulings
